correctness.rationale: Each row of either pump or nonlinear-loss jump has at most one nonzero entry, and each corresponding jump Gram matrix is diagonal. Hence the diagonal of the two dissipators depends only on the diagonal of the input, even though the output can have coherence. The other indicated terms vanish on the output diagonal for any input, including complex diagonal dephasing jumps. This gives the stated one-way population cycle, stationary distribution and determinant z[z²+(3a+b)z+2a²+3ab]. On the zero-sum plane, B=K+m₀Q satisfies B²=(Δ/4)Q. At each real discriminant root the minor −ab and the zero determinant give rank two for K+m₀I and a nonzero rank-one Jordan nilpotent on that plane. The population map is onto and intertwines, so the population minimal polynomial divides the full one; its repeated root forces full defectiveness regardless of other eigenvalues. For vacuum input its deviation is e^(−m₀t)[A cosh(ωt)+C sinh(ωt)/ω], with A=(2a+b)/(2a+3b)>0 and C=(2a²−ab+b²)/(2(2a+3b))>0. Thus it changes sign infinitely often in the open complex-root interval and in fact never crosses outside it or at its endpoints, stronger than the stated at-most-once bound. The endpoint vacuum response has a genuinely nonzero t coefficient. The nonlinear jump supplies a nonzero stationary source √2 b π₂ for the 02 coherence, with strictly negative real damping and no feedback to populations.
residual_risks: The stated proof applies to the exact three-level truncation, not to other truncations or the infinite oscillator. It gives no classification of Jordan blocks on the invariant kernel of the population map. The reported finite checks do not establish the perturbation quantifier.

value.rationale: The result identifies which exact defect survives detuning and dephasing of arbitrary allowed strength in a specified quantum model. Vacuum counts furnish a direct diagnostic of the oscillatory sector and boundary transient without reconstructing coherences. This physical and spectral protection, rather than computing the two roots of a generic cycle, is the useful conclusion.
residual_risks: The analysis does not identify the full Liouvillian gap or exclude additional full-spectrum exceptional points, nor does it apply to drives that change the population map.
